[A] GridBox / LineGridScene
|-- Scene records retain content references and a box tree.
|   |-- LineGridScene { contents: Readonly<Record<string, Diagram>>; root: GridBox }
|   |-- GridBox: id, position, minimumSize?, collapsed, collapsedContentId?
|   |-- A diagram box references content by contentId.
|   `-- A container embeds children and a push-right layout policy.
|-- Grid geometry uses zero-based cells and exclusive right/bottom edges.
|   |-- GridPoint { column: number; row: number }
|   |-- GridSize { columns: number; rows: number }
|   `-- resolveScene(scene): ResolvedGridBox
|       |-- Needs ASCII measurements, parent origins and child bounds.
|       `-- Collapsed boxes require summary content and omit child traversal.
|-- Immutable layout computations
|   |-- updateGridBox(scene, id, update): LineGridScene
|   |-- layoutScene(scene, changedId): LineGridScene
|   |-- Anchors the changed subtree and moves colliding siblings only right.
|   `-- Calls composeScene to validate final bounds before returning.
`-- Composition and spatial queries
    |-- composeScene(scene, renderContent?): string
    |-- Rejects sibling overlaps and allocations beyond the cell limit.
    |-- hitTest(scene, point); findCollisions(scene, parentId, bounds, excludeId?)
    |-- projectMapping(bounds, mapping): GridBounds
    `-- Pure helpers return results; the controller installs edited scenes.
